old='''    best_dx, best_score = 0, -1.0
    for dx in range(-(w - 1), w):
        overlap = sum(sum(1 for c in xs if 0 <= c + dx < w and c + dx in ys)
                      for xs, ys in zip(aa, bb))
        shifted_count = sum(sum(1 for c in xs if 0 <= c + dx < w) for xs in aa)
        other_count = sum(len(ys) for ys in bb)
        score = 2 * overlap / (shifted_count + other_count) if shifted_count + other_count else 0
        if score > best_score:
            best_dx, best_score = dx, score
'''
new='''    best_dx, best_score = 0, -1.0
    for dx in range(-(w - 1), w):
        overlap = sum(sum(1 for c in xs if 0 <= c + dx < w and c + dx in ys)
                      for xs, ys in zip(aa, bb))
        a_count = sum(sum(1 for c in xs if 0 <= c + dx < w) for xs in aa)
        b_count = sum(sum(1 for c in ys if 0 <= c - dx < w) for ys in bb)
        area = len(aa) * (w - abs(dx))
        score = 1 - (a_count + b_count - 2 * overlap) / area
        if score > best_score:
            best_dx, best_score = dx, score
'''
